description: Перелік багатоквартирних будинків міста Багачеве, у яких не менше ніж половина квартир та нежитлових приміщень відокремлена (відключена) від централізованого опалення та гарячого водопостачання is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Багачевська міська рада. List of apartment buildings in the city of Bagachevo, in which at least half of the apartments and non-residential premises are disconnected from the center. heating and hot water supply. Coverage: Багачевська міська рада. The portal shows the English title as "List of multi-apartment buildings in the city of Bagachevo, in which at least half of apartments and non-residential pre" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Багачевська міська рада. Its keywords include перелік, приміщення, відключення, гаряче водопостачання, опалення, багатоквартирні будинки. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
